RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias. In civil service recruitment, panels are typically assembled based on seniority, availability, and relevant department roles. Both candidates presented strong qualifications; her specific background leading international projects or her interview performance likely aligned better with the ministry's immediate strategic needs. 

Furthermore, a two-week delay for written feedback reflects standard public sector administrative pacing, not evasion. Accusing the panel of sex discrimination without concrete evidence would be unfounded and could seriously harm your professional reputation and civil service career. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up inquiry focusing strictly on obtaining constructive feedback and interview scores to aid your future applications.
